summary: Enhancement, still current. Of the five readability asks: float constants in dx.op comments (B), resource names on load/store comments (D, open TODO in dxcdisassembler.cpp) and the ViewID output-dependency table (E) are unchanged across all 20 stable releases; the Resource Bindings table (E) already prints friendly names and always has; source locations (A) are partly served by -Zi. The storeOutput example in ask C was already decoded when filed (op-name table is hctdb-generated for every op) - what is missing is operand VALUE decoding. Two changes since: SM 6.6 annotateHandle now decodes resource properties inline; and, going backwards, v1.4.1907 printed resource-derived value names with no debug flag while v1.5.2010+ requires -Zi -Qembed_debug (mechanism not identified).
title: Suggestion: Improved human-readable values in disassembly
